name: Your name
authIntro: A little clarity. A lot more peace of mind.
authNote: Your money, your pace. Start building a plan that fits your student life.
checkEmail: Check your email for the next step. If you requested a reset and an account exists, a link is on its way.
confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in. If you already have an account, use Sign in.
passwordSaved: Password updated. You can now sign in with your new password.
authFailed: We couldn’t sign you in. Check your details and confirm your email, then try again.
authRequestFailed: The request couldn’t be completed. Please try again shortly.
invalidLink: This email link has expired or is invalid. Request a new link.
heroEyebrow: A calmer way to manage student money
heroTitle:
More campus life.
Less money worry.
heroText: Know what you can spend today, keep the essentials covered, and make your money last until your next allowance.
freeStart: Free to start. No bank connection needed.
exampleNote: With 1,500 ETB in hand, 400 ETB for essentials, and 100 ETB reserved for savings.
builtFor: Made for the days between allowances.
step1Text: Enter the money available right now and choose how long it needs to last.
step2Text: Protect your important payments and set a little aside for your goals.
step3Text: Get a daily guide that adjusts as you record income and expenses.
closingTitle:
One small habit.
A little more breathing room.
closingText: Your next meal, printout, or ride shouldn’t come with a guessing game.
privacyShort: Private by design. Built for student life.
footer: Thoughtful money planning for Ethiopian students.
onboardIntro: A few details today. A clearer plan for the days ahead.
balanceHint: Include cash and mobile money you can spend. Don’t include an allowance that hasn’t arrived.
savingsHint: This protects money in your plan. It does not move money out of your wallet.
essentialHint: Only include payments you still need to make. You can add individual commitments later.
onboardFooter: Everything in your plan can be adjusted later. Your opening balance stays fixed; record income or expenses to change cash.
dashboardIntro: A little direction for the day ahead.
guideNote: A guide, not a guarantee. Based on the money you have, using Addis Ababa time.
allocationNote: Today’s allocation is calculated before today’s everyday spending. New income or plan changes adjust it. Essential payments use their own reserve.
calculation: Here’s how your plan adds up
calculationText: Available balance − unpaid essentials − savings = discretionary money. Divide by remaining days for the average daily guide. On the end date or after it, we use one day until you update your plan.
todayCalculation: Today’s allocation − today’s discretionary spending = left to spend today, capped at your available discretionary money.
attention: A small plan adjustment may help
runwayNote: Based on recorded discretionary spending in the last 7 days. Your actual needs may change.
expectedOnly: An expected allowance is not included in your balance. Record income when it arrives.
noTransactionsText: Add your first expense or income. Your plan will update as you go.
noCommitments: A little space in your plan.
noCommitmentsText: Add an essential payment to protect that money before you spend.
noResultsText: Try a different search or clear your filters.
transactionIntro: The little things, all in one place.
deleteText: This changes your balance or reserved money. Deleting a commitment payment also reopens that commitment.
saved: Saved. Your plan is up to date.
deleted: Record deleted. Your plan has been updated.
settlementLocked: Paid commitments are linked to their payment. Delete the payment first to reopen and edit the commitment.
transactionDateRange: Choose a date from your wallet’s opening date through today.
recordedFrom: Record new cash movements from {date}. Your starting balance already includes earlier activity.
newPeriodText: Your balance, transaction history, and unpaid commitments carry forward. The date and savings reservation below become your new plan. No expected income is added.
payText: Only continue if you have actually paid it. We’ll record the expense and release its reserve together, so it isn’t counted twice.
planExplanation: Unpaid essentials stay protected across planning periods. Paying one reduces both your balance and its reserve by the same amount.
periodHistoryText: Starting a new period never erases transactions. Review past spending in Insights or Transactions.
snapshotNote: Allocations are recorded on days you change your plan or ledger. Missing days are left blank. Editing earlier activity does not rewrite past allocations.
insightsEmpty: A clearer picture is on its way.
insightsEmptyText: Record a few transactions to see your spending patterns here.
topCategory: Your largest expense category is {category}: {amount} in this range.
periodNet: Your recorded income minus expenses for this range is {amount}.
rangeInvalid: The start date must be on or before the end date.
privacyText: Your financial records are private to your account and stored in Supabase. LastBirr does not connect to your bank or move money. Only record information you’re comfortable saving.
planningPreferences: Manage planning dates and savings in Money plan.
signoutFailed: Couldn’t sign out. Please try again.
invalidMoney: Enter an amount with no more than two decimal places (maximum 10 billion ETB).
positiveMoney: Enter an amount greater than zero.
futureTransaction: Only record money that has already moved. Choose today or an earlier date.
futurePlan: Choose today or a future date.
invalidCategory: Choose a category for this transaction type.
invalidForm: Check the form details and try again.
saveFailed: We couldn’t save this change. Check your connection and try again.
sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
databaseUnavailable: Your data couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and make sure the LastBirr database migration has been applied.

warnings.commitmentShortage: Your balance won’t cover all unpaid essentials. Review the amounts and prioritize the payments you need most.
warnings.savingsRisk: Your savings reservation isn’t fully covered after essentials. A smaller reservation may fit this period better.
warnings.overspent: You’ve gone beyond today’s allocation. Keeping the rest of today light will help your money last.
warnings.missingDate: Add a planning end date. Until then, the guide uses one day.
warnings.overdue: Your expected allowance or planning date has passed. Update the date, and only record income when it arrives.
warnings.endsToday: Your plan ends today. Set your next horizon to keep your daily guide useful.
warnings.approaching: Your planning date is close. Check whether your allowance is still on schedule.
warnings.pace: Your recent spending pace is above your daily guide. Review upcoming spending or adjust the plan.
